entities.name: Jaguar Tooth
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth is non-persistent malware that targets Cisco IOS routers.

entities.name: CVE-2017-6742
entities.evidence: It is deployed and executed via exploitation of the patched SNMP vulnerability CVE-2017-6742.

entities.name: T1556 Modify Authentication Process
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth patches two authentication functions to grant access to local accounts for Telnet and physical sessions, without checking the provided password.

entities.name: T1601.001 Modify System Image
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth patches the system image in memory to enable a user authentication bypass.

entities.name: T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth is deployed via an SNMP exploit which grants remote code execution and write-access to the target operating system.

entities.name: T1048.003 Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth exfiltrates collected device information over TFTP.

entities.name: T1020 Automated Exfiltration
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth contains a hard-coded list of Cisco IOS CLI and Tcl commands which are automatically executed and the results exfiltrated over TFTP.

entities.name: T1119 Automated Collection
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth contains a hard-coded list of Cisco IOS CLI and Tcl commands which are automatically executed and the results exfiltrated over TFTP.

entities.name: T1602.002 Data from Configuration Repository
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth utilises a Cisco IOS CLI command to dump the current device running configuration.

entities.name: T1018 Remote System Discovery
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth performs remote system discovery by utilising Cisco IOS CLI commands to obtain ARP and connected devices information.

entities.name: T1083 File and Directory Discovery
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth enumerates the local flash filesystem by utilising a Cisco IOS CLI command.

entities.name: T1016 System Network Configuration Discovery
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth utilises several Cisco IOS CLI commands to discover the system network configuration.

entities.name: T1082 System Information Discovery
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth discovers system information such as interfaces and software versioning by utilising several Cisco IOS CLI commands.
